absent_coverage: The passive-skew (ll/hh) axis is covered only as a separately-recorded supplement on tt MOS (ll/hh x 3 temperatures); combined MOS-corner x resistor-skew points (e.g. ss MOS with res_high) are NOT run -- sky130.lib.spice has no such combined section and no multi-section bundle was built for this campaign.
Mismatch Monte Carlo (comparator input offset, divider ratio mismatch) is NOT run; the numbers are corner values of the nominal drawn circuit, not a distribution.
Sweep rates other than 100 V/s (and its 50 V/s guard) are not simulated; supply-ramp-rate sensitivity of the assembled block is covered by sim/supply-ramp-top.
Post-layout parasitics are not included (schematic-level netlist).
The ideal-bias variant uses a constant 1 uA IBIAS and a 1.25 V VREF at every corner; real bias_core spread is only shown by the separately-reported real-bias-core variant.
author: Loom Builder (Claude Opus 5.5), issue #102

definitions.VPOR-up / VPOR-down: interpolated VDD at which POR_RAW crosses 0.5*VDD (POR_RAW high = above half the instantaneous supply) during the UP / DOWN segment; segments split at the VDD maximum; state evaluated only for VDD >= 1.0 V
definitions.binding corner: the process/temperature point that sets the minimum or maximum of each metric over the corners with a clean, rate-consistent result
definitions.edge extraction: VDD sample step <= 10 mV around an edge, linear interpolation inside the bracket; POR_RAW state evaluated for VDD >= 1 V only
definitions.hysteresis: VPOR-up - VPOR-down at the same process/temperature
definitions.no transition: a segment in which POR_RAW does not change state is reported as no_transition (with the state it stayed in), not omitted; hysteresis is then NO_RESULT
definitions.quasi-static guard: VPOR-up and VPOR-down at the primary rate must agree with the half-rate sweep within 10 mV (stated tolerance, chosen for this campaign, not ratified); otherwise the corner is reported RATE-DEPENDENT and excluded from the binding-corner table
definitions.rates: dVDD/dt is constant and derived from the rate; each rate gets one klt request covering all 15 process x temperature points.
definitions.resolution: an edge is accepted only if the two samples bracketing it differ by <= 10 mV of VDD; otherwise UNRESOLVED
definitions.sweep: V(VDD) = min(peak, rate*t, max(0, 2*peak - rate*t)): UP from a physical 0 V start at +rate V/s to the 3.63 V peak (the DR-001 high rail), then DOWN at -rate V/s to 0 V. Total sweep time 2*peak/rate is derived from the rate, never a fixed duration (gf180 DR-021 confound). VDD is the swept variable, so there is no separate supply axis; the klt corners.supply_v axis carries only the single sweep-peak value. Maximum time step 20 us = 2 mV of VDD at 100 V/s (1 mV at the 50 V/s half-rate guard).

manifest_excerpt.claim: Issue #102 -- NOT a spec claim. Evidence for DR-003 rows 4/5 ([TBD-2] VPOR-up/VPOR-down, [TBD-3] hysteresis): records, for the unchanged design/por_comparator.sch, the VDD at which POR_RAW changes state on a quasi-static constant-dVDD/dt UP sweep (VPOR-up) and DOWN sweep (VPOR-down), their difference (hysteresis), and the margin of VPOR-up against the DR-001 2.97 V low rail, across {tt, ss, ff, sf, fs} x {-40, 27, 125 C}. Each primary sweep rate is paired with a half-rate quasi-staticity guard. Numbers are PROPOSALS for a follow-on DR-003 amendment; spec/ is not edited and nothing here relaxes the ratified spec.

probe:
One single-corner local run (`run_thresholds_campaign.py probe --variant ideal-bias --process tt --temp 27`, `klt sim --backend local`, host ngspice-42, `sim/spiceinit` passed through `options.ngspice_init`), at the same 100 V/s primary rate and the same commit as the grid. Purpose: cross-check the fleet runner (ngspice-46), not to grow the grid.

| quantity | local ngspice-42 | fleet ngspice-46 (tt, 27 C) | local - fleet |
|---|---|---|---|
| VPOR-up | 2.6932 V | 2.6950 V | -1.9 mV |
| VPOR-down | 2.5470 V | 2.5470 V | 0.0 mV |
| hysteresis | 146.2 mV | 148.1 mV | -1.9 mV |

Both runs: one rising edge on the UP segment and one falling edge on the DOWN segment, each bracketed by 2 mV of VDD. The 1.9 mV gap is within one 2 mV VDD sample step, so the two simulators agree to within the sweep's own resolution.

variant.bias_treatment: IDEAL: IBIAS = ideal 1 uA current source into the mirror-input node; VREF = ideal 1.25 V clipped to v(VDD); BIAS_OK = v(VDD) (asserted at every supply). Chosen because the primary question is the divider ratio, the comparator offset and the XRHYS/XMHSW hysteresis network; an ideal VREF/IBIAS removes the bias_core's own process/temperature/startup behavior (issue #86 open items) from the threshold numbers. 1 uA / 1.25 V are the bias_core intended-branch values (sim/bias-core-startup).
variant.description: PRIMARY. Comparator + divider + hysteresis switch isolated from bias_core.
